From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Emma Green <emma@sentryanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchid-XL-2.0 onboarding timeline and specs -- hold request

Emma — thanks for the package. Internal folks — quick ask: before we start ingesting Orchid-XL-2.0 into the intake pipeline I want to request a temporary ingress hold (no auto-ingress) and a version pin for the variant until compat checks + telemetry are in place. Reasoning below.

Summary of immediate findings from a quick run:
- Tokenizer: spec indicates a custom BPE with non-standard byte handling. We saw mismatches when running our standard normalization pipeline.
- KV cache layout: model uses an atypical KV ordering that could produce cache misses and incorrect attention on multi-turn sessions.
- Quantization: weights look friendly but we need a tolerance check for int8 paths on A100/4xA2 kernels.

Risks if we proceed without a temporary pin: degraded chat continuity for customers, incorrect token-level metrics that will bias quality dashboards, and possible fallback churn if runtime auto-selects an incompatible kernel.

Request / asks:
1) Runtime (Karthik) — can you run a targeted compatibility pass (tokenizer parity, KV ordering, int8 sanity) and return a short report and list of failing tests? Attachments: compat_report_v0.3.pdf (placeholder).
2) Product (Laura) — we need a decision to hold ingress and delay scheduled canary until we approve. If we pin now, what does that mean for Sentry Analytics' pilot date?
3) QA (Soojin & Priyom) — prepare a small prompt set (10 representative flows) that reproduces prefix/KV scenarios; include the political/credentials redaction prompts Emma flagged.

Emma, well keep you in the loop. If the incompatibilities are minor we can ship a compatibility shim; if not well coordinate a short runway.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior PM, Model Intake
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Green <emma@sentryanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchid-XL-2.0 onboarding timeline and specs -- initial compat pass

Quick update from runtime triage (attached: compat_report_v0.3.pdf):

What I ran:
- Tokenizer parity test (our tokenizer vs provided tokenizer) on 2k sentences from example_inputs.csv
- KV cache shape + ordering introspection on a single forward/backward session (seq len 2048)
- int8 quantization forward pass on an A100 (dev) and 4xA2 (staging) using our quant runner

Findings (short):
- Tokenizer: ~3.7% tokenization divergence on the sample set. Root cause: the provided tokenizer treats non-breaking hyphen sequences as single tokens; our normalization splits them. We can add a shim to normalization but need to confirm production tokenizers are stable.
- KV cache: model uses key/val packing that flips block ordering for even-numbered layers. This is not compatible with our current KV-matmul kernel assumption and will cause misaligned cache reads in long conversations. We can patch at runtime by adding a per-model layer-order toggle, but its invasive and requires additional regression tests.
- int8: forward passes returned numerically comparable logits on A100 but we see 12-18% degradation on 4xA2 kernel selection path for one particular attention head; not catastrophic but may surface as hallucination variance.

Recommendations:
1) Place temporary ingress hold + pin variant to staging-only until we ship a runtime shim for KV ordering.
2) Instrument telemetry: tokenization divergence metric + KV-miss counters + head-level log-ratio for the int8 path. We need these surfaced to Console before canary.
3) If Product needs the pilot date preserved, propose a mitigated canary limited to internal and Sentry dev account with explicit read-only quotas.

I'll attach a proposed test matrix (see compat_report_v0.3.pdf). ETA for a shim + telemetry: 7 business days (two engineers + one QA).

-Karthik
Principal Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Green <emma@sentryanalytics.com>

Subject: Re: Orchid-XL-2.0 onboarding timeline and specs -- product impact + canary ask

Thanks for the triage. Laura here — a couple of product notes and a suggested decision path: 

Impact notes:
- If we pin and delay public canary, Sentrys pilot (target 5/24) will likely slip ~10 business days given Karthiks 7-day ETA. Thats acceptable for an early pilot but we should surface the trade to the customer.
- If we run a mitigated canary (internal + Sentry dev account), we can preserve the pilot window but with reduced SDS (surface discovery) guarantees and a temporary SLA waiver.

Decision options (pick one):
A) Hold ingress + full pin -> runway for shim + telemetry -> public canary after green signal (recommended for safety).
B) Partial canary -> limited exposure to Sentry devs with telemetry gating; escalate to legal for SLA note.
C) Proceed without changes -> not recommended.

Ask: Go/No-Go on option A vs B by EOD 2027-05-12 so we can communicate to Sentry (Emma) and procurement. Also need a short blurb to give Emma about what the shim does and why were pausing.

I'll draft the customer-facing blurb if you want; Jordan, Karthik — can you confirm the 7-business-day ETA and list of engineers?

-Laura
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

- Soojin / Priyom: assemble the 10-flow prompt set and run the proposed regression matrix; return report by 2027-05-19. Attach example_inputs.csv for reference.
- Laura: prepare customer-facing blurb and notify Sentry + procurement by 2027-05-13 morning.
- Jordan: create gated canary plan (internal-only) as contingency and file JIRA-REQ-4127 for tracking.

Emma — thank you for the model package and patience. Well aim to keep the pilot window tight and will update you by 5/13 with the confirmed plan. If Sentry needs the pilot earlier, we can consider the mitigated canary (Option B) but will require SLA language and explicit telem gating.

Attachments referenced: compat_report_v0.3.pdf, example_inputs.csv
